column1: # Jōyō kanji table (常用漢字表), 本表 (main table): every kanji and every on and kun reading.
# Source: Agency for Cultural Affairs (文化庁), 常用漢字表, Cabinet Notice No. 2 of 30 November 2010
#   (平成22年内閣告示第2号), official PDF:
# A cabinet notice: generally outside copyright under Art. 13 of the Japanese Copyright Act; cited as
# Extracted from the PDF text layer (W01-3), in table order: 2,136 kanji, 2,352 on and 2,036 kun
#   readings, as in the table. Indented (limited-use) readings are included. Not included: the 付表
#   (word readings such as 明日 あす, which belong to words, not to single kanji), the 備考 notes,
#   the traditional forms in （ ） and the permitted forms in ［ ］.
# Readings use KANJIDIC notation: on'yomi in katakana, kun'yomi in hiragana, "." before okurigana.
#   The table marks no okurigana in the reading column; the split is taken from the table's example
#   words (哀れむ -> あわ.れむ; 恋い慕う -> こ.う).
# PENDING rows: the examples do not settle the okurigana split (W01-3 OPEN-Q Q10); they are
#   commented out until the owner answers.
